new.s: Sir Stafford Cripps was a member of the War Cabinet of which British Prime Minister?
new.x: Cripps, a Labour member, sat in Winston Churchill's War Cabinet; Churchill sent him to India in 1942.
new.angle: U0241 #1 Cripps Mission -> British PM

new.s: Along with Jawaharlal Nehru, who was the official Congress negotiator with the Cripps Mission?
new.x: Nehru and Maulana Abul Kalam Azad, then Congress President, negotiated with Cripps for the Congress.
new.angle: U0241 #1 Cripps Mission -> Congress negotiators

new.s: Which British mission arrived in India in March 1942?
new.x: The Cripps Mission reached Delhi on 22-23 March 1942; the Cabinet Mission came in March 1946.
new.angle: U0241 #1 Cripps Mission -> month and year; PYQ y7ce35333b2a date of an event

new.s: In which year did the Second World War begin, when India was declared a party to it without consulting Indians?
new.x: Lord Linlithgow declared India a party to the Second World War in September 1939, and the Congress ministries resigned in protest.
new.angle: U0241 PYQ y56708931a8a period of the Second World War

new.s: Who coined the phrase 'Quit India'?
new.x: The phrase 'Quit India' was coined by Yusuf Meherally; Gandhi used it in Harijan in April 1942.
new.angle: U0242 #1 Slogans of the Quit India phase -> coiner

new.s: In which ground of Bombay was the Quit India resolution ratified on 8 August 1942?
new.x: The AICC met at Gowalia Tank Maidan, now called August Kranti Ground, and ratified the resolution on 8 August 1942.
new.angle: U0242 #3 Quit India resolution -> ground in Bombay; PYQ y360cd07194f venue angle

new.s: On which date was Operation Zero Hour, the pre-dawn arrest of Congress leaders, carried out?
new.x: Leaders were arrested before dawn on 9 August 1942, the day after the resolution, and the movement then began.
new.angle: U0242 #3 Quit India -> launch date

new.s: The burning of the Madras-Puri train at Tenali in August 1942 took place during which movement?
new.x: After the police firing at Tenali on 12 August 1942, crowds burnt the Madras-Puri train; this was part of the Quit India Movement.
new.angle: U0242 PYQ yc93d46636f7 Andhra incident -> movement

new.s: Kala Venkata Rao is known as the author of which document of the Quit India period?
new.x: Kala Venkata Rao drafted the Andhra Circular of 29 July 1942, called the Kurnool Circular because police seized it at Kurnool.
new.angle: U0243 #2 Kurnool Circular -> author; PYQ y7767e3e47d9 / y5457ccf8666 / y3b0ed645209

new.s: Who wrote the diary 'Feathers and Stones' while jailed at Ahmednagar Fort?
new.x: Pattabhi Sitaramayya, a Working Committee member, was held at Ahmednagar Fort and wrote the diary 'Feathers and Stones'.
new.angle: U0243 PYQ y7767e3e47d9 author angle (Andhra leader -> writing)

new.s: The march of 500 students to the Sub-Magistrate's court at Chirala on 12 August 1942 was part of which movement?
new.x: On 12 August 1942, 500 students marched at Chirala to close the court, one of the Quit India actions in Andhra.
new.angle: U0243 PYQ y34c65dd3efa Andhra event -> movement

new.s: Who was the chairman of the National Planning Committee set up in 1938?
new.x: The National Planning Committee was set up under Congress President Bose, but its chairman was Jawaharlal Nehru; K.T. Shah was Secretary.
new.angle: U0244 #2/#11 National Planning Committee -> chairman

new.s: Which body was set up by the Congress in 1938, when Subhas Chandra Bose was its President?
new.x: The National Planning Committee was set up in 1938 under Bose; the Forward Bloc came in 1939 and the Planning Commission in 1950.
new.angle: U0244 #2/#11 NPC -> year; PYQ y77cf03d66d0

new.s: Who was the Congress President when the National Planning Committee was set up in 1938?
new.x: Bose presided over the Haripura session of 1938, and the National Planning Committee was set up under him.
new.angle: U0244 #2 NPC; PYQ yb911418c24f idea of planning -> Netaji

new.s: After the fall of which city in February 1942 was the first INA formed from Indian prisoners of war?
new.x: Captain Mohan Singh formed the first INA in Singapore from Indian POWs taken after the fall of Singapore in February 1942.
new.angle: U0244 #7 INA -> place of formation; PYQ y8fd9839d503

new.s: Which INA officer tried at the Red Fort later became a Union minister?
new.x: Shah Nawaz Khan, one of the three officers tried at the Red Fort, later became a Union minister.
new.angle: U0244 #13 Red Fort trials -> accused officers; PYQ y822499cf6c3
